description: IDTA 02004 Handover Documentation 2.0/2.0.1: IRDI submodel id, VDI 2770 classification, 1.2->2.0 renames, DocumentVersion rules, DigitalFile semantics, 2.0.1 bug fix.

items.question: Our detector recognises Handover Documentation submodels by an admin-shell.io/vdi/2770 IRI. What is the submodel semanticId of IDTA 02004 v2.0?
items.expected_answer: The ECLASS IRDI 0173-1#01-AHF578#003 (idShort HandoverDocumentation) - not an admin-shell.io IRI.

citation.section: 2.4, Table 2 Attributes of the Submodel instance

items.question: What exact value must ClassificationSystem carry for the VDI 2770 classification in Handover Documentation 2.0?

citation.section: 2.3 Enumeration: document classification according to VDI 2770 Blatt 1:2020
citation.quote: This classification is understood as ClassificationSystem identified by the value "VDI 2770 Blatt 1:2020" within this Submodel template.

items.question: Which VDI 2770 ClassId and ClassName should an operating manual get?

citation.section: 2.3, Table 1 DocumentClassification according to VDI 2770 Blatt 1:2020

items.question: Can a Document in Handover Documentation 2.0 be classified only according to IEC 61355?
items.expected_answer: No. Additional systems are allowed, but the classification according to VDI 2770 Blatt 1:2020 is mandatory.

citation.quote: The classification according to VDI 2770 Blatt 1:2020 is mandatory in the Submodel Handover Documentation.

items.question: ClassName is a MultiLanguageProperty. Which language is mandatory in it?
items.expected_answer: English (EN) is mandatory; other languages may be added.

citation.quote: While the latter can be given in multiple languages, EN is mandatory.

items.question: Migrating a 1.2 handover: what are DocumentVersionId and Summary called in 2.0?
items.expected_answer: DocumentVersionId became Version and Summary became Description, each with a new semanticId (non-backward compatible).

citation.section: Annex C, Table 15 List of changes (items 6 and 7)
citation.quote: Property DocumentVersionId changed to Version with new SemanticId 7 x Property Summary changed to Description with new SemanticId.

items.question: What replaced the 1.2 property ValueId inside DocumentId in Handover Documentation 2.0?

citation.section: Annex C, Table 15 List of changes (item 9)

items.question: Which values should StatusValue of a DocumentVersion take?

citation.quote: The following two values should be used for the application of this guideline: InReview (under review), Released (released)

items.question: A manual exists as two separate PDFs, one English and one German. Do we model one Document with two DocumentVersions?
items.expected_answer: No. A document existing in multiple languages is represented by different Documents; a single DocumentVersion with several languages is only for one file that contains multiple languages.

citation.quote: If a document exists in multiple languages, it shall be represented by different "Documents". If a document features multiple languages within itself, it shall be represented by a single "DocumentVersion" with multiple associated languages.

items.question: Can we split one document into chapters across several DigitalFile entries of the same DocumentVersion?
items.expected_answer: No. If multiple DigitalFiles with different MIME types are used, each represents the DocumentVersion in total and must contain equal content.

citation.quote: each of them is assumed to represent the "DocumentVersion" in total and must contain equal content

items.question: Which file format does Handover Documentation (per VDI 2770) require for DigitalFile, and must every DocumentVersion have one?
items.expected_answer: PDF/A (ISO 19005-1/-2/-3, i.e. PDF/A-1, -2, -3); every DocumentVersion shall contain at least one DigitalFile.

citation.quote: According to VDI 2770, PDF/A files are required including ISO 19005-1, ISO 19005-2 and ISO 19005-3

items.question: What semanticId does OrganizationShortName have in Handover Documentation 2.0 - an ECLASS IRDI like its siblings?
items.expected_answer: No IRDI is printed: its semanticId is the URL https://api.eclass-cdp.com/0173-1-02-ABI002-003 with no supplementalSemanticId (the official 2.0.1 template JSON does the same).
items.notes: Confirmed in the 2.0.1 template JSON (OrganizationShortName semanticId = the cdp URL, no supplementals).

items.question: The 2.0 PDF prints no cardinality for DocumentVersion inside the DocumentVersions list. What cardinality does the official template file give?
items.expected_answer: OneToMany (1..*) per the SMT/Cardinality qualifier in the official 2.0.1 template JSON.

citation.document: IDTA 02004 Handover Documentation - official template JSON

items.question: Is 2.0 still the latest Handover Documentation release, and what did the next release fix?
items.expected_answer: No. 2.0.1 (November 2025) is a bug-fix release: issue #196 fixed ClassName's displayName, which had 'en' twice (the 'Klassenname' text is now 'de'), plus typo fixes (#147).

citation.revision: 2.0.1 (November 2025, admin-shell-io/submodel-templates mirror, tree sha f3790038b6c9, mirrored 2026-10-06)
citation.section: Annex C, Changes Version 2.0 to Version 2.0.1
citation.quote: The language of the LangString with text "Klassenname" was changed to "de".

items.question: Migrating from Handover Documentation 1.2: which submodel semanticId did the official 1.2 template use, and how does it differ from 2.0?
items.expected_answer: The official 1.2 template JSON uses the ECLASS IRDI 0173-1#01-AHF578#001 (as a ModelReference with key type Submodel); 2.0 uses 0173-1#01-AHF578#003. Both are IRDIs, not admin-shell.io IRIs.
